name: yahoo_shopping_jp-mcp
description: Yahoo! Shopping (JP) (ecommerce channels): me, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listing. Every too

platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_client_id.description: Yahoo! JAPAN Client ID (アプリケーションID) of an app approved for the Shopping store APIs, linked to the store's Business ID.

platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_client_se.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_client_se.description: The app's シークレット (sent as HTTP Basic to the YConnect v2 token endpoint).

platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_refresh_t.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_refresh_t.description: YConnect v2 refresh token from one authorization-code consent by the store's Yahoo! JAPAN ID (https://developer.yahoo.co.jp/webapi/shopping/help/#accesstoken). It lasts 4 weeks; re-consent afterwards.

platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_seller_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_SHOPPING_JP_SELLER_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_shopping_jp_seller_id.description: ストアアカウント (store account id, lower-case letters, digits, - and _).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe lists the store's top-level store categories (ストアカテゴリ一覧API) to verify the token and seller_id.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: 在庫更新API: sets the stock of one item. `sku` is the 商品コード, or 商品コード:個別商品コード for a variant (e.g. item-01:sub-01); the quantity replaces the current stock. Applies immediately (no publish step). If Yahoo answers 207 the item carries an error_code (e.g. st-02104) and was NOT updated — check error_code.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: 商品一括更新API for one item (listing_id = 商品コード): sets 通常販売価格 (price, whole yen, required). The docs require price and sale_price together, so sale_price is sent empty — this REMOVES any 特価 on the item. The change is staged: status is OK/NG (per-field errors under raw.Result) and it goes live only after 全反映予約 (reservePublish / ストアクリエイターPro). Title/description are not changed here; stock is set_inventory.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: Sets ページ公開 display=0 (非公開) for one item via 商品一括更新API; reversible (display=1) and not a deletion. Staged until the next 全反映予約 (reservePublish / ストアクリエイターPro). status is OK or NG.
